runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification and link evidence. Content age and source-verification age are separate; touching updatedAt alone never makes a job fresh.
runSummary.note: Fresh 13.9.2026 06:05 public-web sweep across 13 actually searched source families. No new unique promotion-grade job passed ranking, language, trust/economics and locality gates, so jobs-data.json remains fail-closed at 52 LIVE items. Direct-company recheck reconfirmed Oveckarna CZ/SK seasonal support as remote-ok and active. StartupJobs surfaced Medevio BDR SK as 100% remote with 34-56k CZK, but it is outbound phone sales and lower-ranking than current support/admin targets; Digitoo Junior Customer Support is Prague-based with remote/hybrid wording but no evidence of Slovakia-executable work; Ecomail Poland support is on-site Prague and Polish-language. LinkedIn surfaced Concentrix Czech-language home-office support in Slovakia, but it requires native Czech plus communicative spoken/written English; Allegro Junior partner support is 100% home office and excellent e-commerce fit but requires fluent Hungarian and Slovak. SupportYourApp remains fluent/C1 English or T3-heavy. Reddit public results included a remote WordPress/WooCommerce content-assistant hiring post, but it is older and highly saturated; Facebook public indexing yielded 0 concrete verified hiring posts with direct links.

developmentChanges.title: Index freshness vs job freshness detector
developmentChanges.reason: Search engines often recrawl an old listing today and make it look fresh. Persist both crawl/index freshness and canonical published/updated dates, and never prioritize a role as <24h unless the employer/job page itself proves the job is new or materially refreshed. This prevents wasting application time on stale inventory that only looks current because of recrawling.

developmentChanges.title: Support vs outbound-sales intensity classifier
developmentChanges.reason: Separate genuine support/order-admin roles from outbound calling, lead qualification, upsell and quota-driven sales. Score channel mix and outbound share explicitly so apparently relevant customer-care titles do not outrank calmer e-shop, technical-support and back-office roles that fit the target profile better.
